text: I think the first thing we need to realize is that change management is a lifelong commitment. Okay, so, and a lot of companies get that wrong. We need people and companies that focus on it permanently.

text: We need to stop telling people what to do. We need to explain to them why it's good for them. Because if you explain to someone why it's good for them, they'll start following on their own as well.
